introMd: Horror RNG is a Roblox game where you use eerie auras to spook other players while chasing rare items through random luck. The game’s core thrill comes from boosting your chances to get powerful auras that make your scares more effective. Horror RNG codes unlock temporary luck boosts, giving you an edge in finding those rare, spooky auras faster. These codes are simple to redeem and instantly activate, making every moment in the game more intense and rewarding.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Horror RNG Codes

There are no special requirements or level limits to redeem codes in Horror RNG. You just need to be in the game and ready to enter the codes. Here’s how you can redeem your codes step-by-step:

1. [[roblox_link|Launch Horror RNG]] on your Roblox player.
2. Look for the Codes option at the top left corner of the screen and select it.
3. Type or paste a working code into the text box.
4. Press Enter to redeem the code and instantly receive your rewards.

That’s it! Your luck boost will activate immediately after redeeming the code.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?

When you redeem Horror RNG codes, you mainly receive luck boosts that increase your chances of obtaining rare auras. These boosts vary in strength and duration, directly affecting how often you get powerful items during gameplay. Here’s a clear look at the typical rewards:

| Reward Type       | Details                                           |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| 2x Luck Boost     | Doubles your luck for 20 minutes, enhancing rare aura drops significantly (e.g., code: MURDERER). |
| 1.5x Luck Boost   | Increases luck by 1.5 times for 15 to 35 minutes, improving your odds moderately (codes: 5000WOWS, 10000HORRORS). |
| Standard Luck Boost| Provides a basic luck increase for 15 to 20 minutes, giving a slight edge in aura drops (codes: THANKYOU2000, 500LIKES, RELEASE). |

Each luck boost directly impacts your aura hunting, making your spooky encounters more rewarding and unpredictable in a good way.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes, Horror RNG codes don’t redeem properly because they have expired or were entered incorrectly. Double-check spelling and capitalization. Also, the game occasionally releases codes randomly without an official channel, so some codes might no longer be active. Unlike other games, Horror RNG doesn’t require you to reach a certain level or complete tasks to redeem codes, so no gameplay restrictions block redemption.
